first_step_test: A broad round outer frame at the final size gives a beginner one stable contour and clear room for a drumhead and jingle slots.

source.notes: Six-panel handmade felt-tip contact sheet; rejected iterations, if any, remain private in drafts.

final_elements.name: outer tambourine frame
final_elements.description: One slightly uneven round black marker outline.

final_elements.name: inner drumhead circle
final_elements.description: One smaller concentric black contour with a wide frame band between circles.

final_elements.name: three jingle slots
final_elements.description: Exactly three small rounded openings on the frame at upper-left, upper-right and lower-center.

final_elements.name: three jingle centers
final_elements.description: One dark inner curved metal mark inside each of the three jingle slots.

final_elements.name: two shake arcs
final_elements.description: Exactly two short detached motion arcs outside the right edge.

final_elements.name: three head hatches
final_elements.description: Exactly three short diagonal texture lines on the upper-left drumhead.

frames.visible_job: Draw one broad uneven circle in black felt tip.
frames.instruction: In black felt tip, draw one broad round outline at the page center, keeping the ring a little handmade rather than compass-perfect.

frames.visible_job: Add one inner circle to create a wide frame band.
frames.instruction: Draw a smaller circle inside the first, leaving a wide band all around for the metal jingles.

frames.visible_job: Add three separate openings in the frame band.
frames.instruction: Draw three small rounded slots in the frame band: one upper left, one upper right, and one at the bottom center. Keep all three separate from the inner circle.

frames.visible_job: Draw one small dark metal curve inside each slot.
frames.instruction: Inside each of the three slots, draw one small dark curved metal mark. Count three jingle centers before moving on.

frames.visible_job: Add two right-side motion arcs and three drumhead hatches.
frames.instruction: Outside the right edge, add two short separate shake arcs. On the upper-left drumhead, draw three small diagonal hatches without crossing the inner rim.

final_step.visible_job: Fill the established frame, drumhead and three jingles with textured marker color.
final_step.instruction: Fill the frame band with coral marker, the drumhead with pale yellow, and the three existing jingle slots with teal. Keep their dark centers, two shake arcs, and three head hatches crisp under the color.
adds: coral, pale yellow and teal marker fill on established contours

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square crop shows only one thick slightly wobbly black oval at page center, leaving a broad empty interior for the drumhead.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Six saved square crops build one fixed tilted tambourine: inner ring, three fixed jingle slots, one inner metal curve in each, two right-side shake arcs and three head hatches before streaky coral, yellow and teal fill. No guides or unexplained structural loss.

transitions.instruction_match: The slot instruction matches the three separate openings and their locations.

transitions.observed_addition: Both rings and all three slots persist; one smaller dark curve appears inside each slot, three new metal centers total.
transitions.instruction_match: The jingle instruction matches one inner curve in each of the three slots.

transitions.observed_addition: All three jingle centers persist; two separate motion arcs appear to the right and three diagonal hatches appear in the upper-left drumhead.
transitions.instruction_match: The motion-and-head instruction matches exactly two arcs and three hatches.

transitions.observed_addition: The rings, three slots and centers, two motion arcs and three hatches remain; coral, pale yellow and teal marker fills their established areas.
